entries.notes: R 栏作「bol.」，非官话对音（疑为参见/重复类记号），故据 H「到」与 M「cañ」定音义。

entries.en: to reach; to attain to; to overtake

entries.zh: 到达某处（该栏连书数句例句，多处漶损）
entries.en: to arrive at a place (the column runs several example phrases together and is badly damaged)
entries.notes: M 栏为一串连书例句且有 T99 漶损，H「泡」已标 [疑:泡/到]，仅能定其大意为「到达某处」。

entries.en: to go to; to betake oneself to; to arrive in time
entries.notes: L 栏「Llegar ado ùa con tiempo」有漶字，义取「趁时赶到」，与 赴（前往、赴期）相合。

entries.zh: 敷：施及、铺陈；（西语义不合，存疑）
entries.en: to spread; to extend to (the Spanish lemma does not fit this sense)
entries.notes: L 栏「llegar a el juicio」与 敷 义不相涉，疑为 赴/敷 同音异调之对照条而西语误置。

entries.en: to proceed to; to betake oneself to; to go up to
entries.notes: L 栏「Llegar adoi -」残，疑为 adonde；义据 就（即、趋就）与 M「chiū」定。

entries.zh: 額（额头；数额）；（西语义不合，存疑）
entries.en: forehead; amount, quota (does not agree with the Spanish lemma)
entries.notes: L 栏「algara/alguna cosa … a el juicio」本身已标疑，与 H「額」、M「cañ jieg」难以互证。

entries.en: to encroach upon; to approach, to draw near
entries.notes: 「aoraue」疑为 aunque；L 谓虽遣使亦可近前，正合 侵（渐近、侵逼）。

entries.en: to arrive at (a term); to fall due; to be fulfilled
entries.notes: M 栏「tremo」不明，疑为术语残写；义据 届（至、及期）与 L「aver llegado, cumplido」定。
H「泡」有 [疑:泡/到]，据 M「tâu lāy」及例句定为「到來」。

entries.en: to draw near; to come close
entries.notes: H「近」标 [疑:近/行]，M 作「quīn」，与 近 相合，故取「近」。

entries.en: to arrive safely (of a ship); safe and sound

entries.zh: 时运到：时来运转，运气临身
entries.en: one's time (luck) has come; fortune arrives
one's fortune has arrived; the luck has come
to arrive by boarding (a boat or carriage); to come aboard
entries.notes: 三字连读「搭＋到＋来」，取马尼拉商旅搭船而至之义。

entries.en: to arrive here; to reach (this place)
entries.notes: 中间一字标 [疑:泡/到]，与首字「到」重出，仍定为「到…来」。

entries.zh: 搭着天：直达天际，高与天齐
entries.en: to reach the sky; to be sky-high
entries.notes: M 作「tâ tió sy」，末音节与 H「天」不合，L「ciedo」亦漶，仅存大意。
L「a el cuerpo ot el radio」与「搭私」均难通，疑有夺字或错行。
